name: Cointegration
description: Find price series that drift together and trade the gap between them.

lessonNames.l1-two-walks: Two random walks that look related
lessonNames.l6-z-score: How far is the spread stretched?

lessonObjectives.l1-two-walks: Regress one random walk on another and get a convincing false fit.
lessonObjectives.l2-not-correlation: Contrast correlated returns with cointegrated prices.
lessonObjectives.l3-stays-put: Define cointegration as a stationary combination of two series.
lessonObjectives.l4-engle-granger: Test a pair for cointegration with the two-step method.
lessonObjectives.l5-hedge-ratio: Estimate the hedge ratio by regression, and see why the direction matters.
lessonObjectives.l6-z-score: Standardise the spread as a z-score.
lessonObjectives.l7-snap-back: Estimate the half-life of the spread.
lessonObjectives.l8-johansen: Read a Johansen test for several series.
lessonObjectives.l9-entry-exit: Set entry and exit thresholds for a spread trade.
lessonObjectives.l10-backtesting-a-pair: Backtest a pair with costs and no look-ahead.
lessonObjectives.l11-breakdown: Detect a broken pair and decide when to stop trading it.
lessonObjectives.l12-real-pair: Test a pair of real price series for cointegration from start to finish.
